newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan dealer to sell Opel's new Vectra Wagon.
newsitem.headline: Japan dealer to sell Opel's new Vectra Wagon.

text.p: Yanase and Co Ltd, a major foreign car dealer, said on Thursday it would start selling Adam Opel AG's new Vectra Wagon in Japan.
The new Vectra Wagon will go on sale on March 8 with a sales target of 4,000 units by September, a Yanase spokesman said. Adam Opel is the German unit of General Motors Corp .
The Japanese selling price will range from 2.66 million yen to 3.22 million yen.
The new Vectra Wagon has a large trunk and its safety features include dual airbags and an anti-lock brake system.
Yanase plans to sell a total of 46,000 Opel brand cars in Japan in the business year to September 1997, up from 39,496 a year earlier, the spokesman said.
